shortDescription: Deutsche Bank XETR:DBK Chief Financial Officer Raja Akram said on Wednesday that the lender's investment bank revenue is likely to be flat to slightly down in the third quarter from a year earlier.Akram, speaking at a financial conference, noted that the previous year was particularly strong.
